ghi_chu: Ban ve lay NGUYEN tu so tay (core/manual_drawing.py tach net vector). File nay chi noi o nao tren ban ve ung voi nguon tin hieu nao, de to mau gia tri. Moi dong: [nguon, kieu, nhan tren giay]. Nguon: pin:N chan vao, ra:N chan ra. Dot nay chi neo chan vao/ra; o hien thi (reg:OPS_OUTn) va nut man hinh (ops:OPS_INn) chua map. Chan ra DEV HI hang ghi 'DEV HH' tren giay.
